slides.texte_overlay:
30 things you must do alone
to truly know yourself

1. Watch a sunrise.
2. Eat at a bar counter.
3. Visit a museum.
4. Take a train somewhere new.
5. Sit by water for an hour.

6. Walk across your city.
7. Go to the cinema.
8. Cook a three-course dinner.
9. Write a letter to your future self.
10. Climb a hill at sunset.

11. Learn a new skill.
12. Read a full book in a day.
13. Learn one new thing daily.
14. Spend a day offline.
15. Plan your next five years.

slides.texte_overlay:
16. Run your longest distance.
17. Try a class where you know no one.
18. Fix something broken.
19. Go camping for a night.
20. Swim in the sea.

21. Celebrate a win quietly.
22. Forgive someone in your head.
23. Sit with a hard feeling.
24. Say no without explaining.
25. Clean your space slowly.

26. Take a long drive.
27. Visit where you grew up.
28. Make a decision without asking.
29. Thank yourself out loud.
30. Start something you've put off.
